1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Bb5 g6 4.O-O Bg7 5.R.strategy: Offers the b-pawn to pull Black's c-pawn away from the centre, aiming at a broad pawn centre and open lines. It is an unusual wing gambit that costs a pawn for the sake of initiative and space, and Black can accept it calmly.
